name: 60451 · New Lenox, IL
findings: ZIP 60451 (New Lenox) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60451 (New Lenox) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60451 (New Lenox) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60451 (New Lenox) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
